mechanism: Combined serotonergic and noradrenergic activity increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis; lisdexamfetamine's stimulant effects may potentiate duloxetine's noradrenergic activity.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia, tremor) and hypertension; consider alternative ADHD treatment or use lowest effective doses with frequent blood pressure monitoring.
